prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training peak week - maximize carbohydrate intake and hydration for endurance performance

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all meals for one full day (breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks)
Emphasizes high carbohydrate intake appropriate for peak marathon training week
Includes hydration strategy with specific fluid recommendations throughout the day
Provides realistic, practical meal options that can be consumed by a single athlete
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a professional marathon runner requiring high carbohydrate intake and hydration strategy during peak training week
